title: Paste with AI - Add Claude
author: tglaesmann
summary: Adding a first-class Anthropic Claude provider is a product/provider-support decision, not a missing reporter-detail problem or accepted implementation plan.

status.label: Requires provider product decision
status.detail: Asking the reporter to choose authentication and protocol architecture would not resolve ownership.

next_action.label: No automated public action
next_action.reason: Leave provider prioritization and credential-model decisions to Advanced Paste maintainers.

judgment.rationale: The feature request is understandable, but no maintainer accepted a direct Anthropic provider or selected its endpoint and credential model.
evidence: The issue asks for Claude and says a workaround is required.
The current provider registry has no Anthropic type.
The only cross-reference is a closed PR in a contributor fork.
There is no assignee, milestone, or maintainer direction.
judgment.recommended_action: Keep normal product triage; do not ask the reporter to make architecture decisions or expose fix approval.

issue_context.summary: The reporter wants Claude available alongside existing Paste with AI providers.
known_information: Claude is the reporter’s preferred service.
Paste with AI supports multiple local and online providers.
The reporter says a workaround exists.
inferences: Direct Anthropic support requires credential storage, endpoint/version handling, model enumeration, policy, privacy, and tests.
A compatible gateway may serve some users, but that is a maintainer choice.
issue_context.analysis: The prior request-info action delegated product architecture to the reporter. Recognize the feature request but withhold implementation action until maintainers select strategy.
initial_investigation: The only timeline cross-reference is closed Sthitadhi1/PowerToys PR #2 outside upstream.

information_gaps.information: Maintainer decision on direct Anthropic support versus compatible gateways.
information_gaps.why_needed: Determines whether a provider should be designed.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Advanced Paste product-owner triage, not another reporter question.
